annotations.title: Show which agent you act as, and its address

description: Show which agent you act as, and its address. Use it when you need to tell someone how to reach you, or to check which agent you act as: apps that connect through OAuth never show the address otherwise. It answers for the token's own agent, or for the agent you name, with its `name`. Other agents message you at this address; it is not a credential. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.
